notes.title: The Carla update
notes.content:
[h2]This March 27 update includes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New lewd scene[/b] - If you like the Carla character, this update is for you.
[*] [b]More agency[/b] - You can now drive the interaction with Carla in Episode 1 much more. 
[*] [b]Reworked graphics[/b] - All images with Carla in Episode 1 has been adjusted and re-rendered.
[*] [b]New achievement[/b] - linked to the new content, there's one new achievements to find.
[/list]

[h2]Update history since release[/h2]

[h3]March 21 2025[/h3]

The update included
[list]
[*] [b]More agency[/b] - This release focused on 
[list]
[*] [b]Episode 3[/b], where your choice not to take Tom to the campfire will change the experience of the episode and add another scene.
[*] [b]Episode 4[/b], where the MC can decline to go test driving with Synne. This opens a new scene with some nice content - if you can play Milena the right way. New location built from scratch.
[*] [b]Episode 5[/b], where a bit of the same dynamic is at play with Swathi if you choose to go get the car you left the night before. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Reworked graphics[/b] - the scene with the felled three in Episode 3 has been totally reworked with a location built from scratch - a place you will later have the option to return to with Swathi.
[*] [b]New achievements[/b] - linked to the new content, there are also two new achievements to find.
[/list]

[h3]March 11 2025[/h3]

This update included:
[list]
[*] [b]More agency[/b] - gradually the game's different branches will be implemented. This release focuses on Episode 1, where the MC can decline the sample with the nurse. From there, the episode has a slightly different trajectory and events unfold in another manner, giving a different experience of the episode.
[*] [b]Reworked graphics[/b] - the usage of photo bubbles has been reduced for pure 3D imagery in the transport scenes in Episode 2. In addition, there has been an upgrade to several scenes in Episode 1.
[*] [b]Fixed achievements[/b] - the bug in Season 1 resetting the achievements should nov have been fixed. There are also a number of new achievments, quite a few of them related to story branching events.
[/list]


If you [b]enjoyed playing[/b] The Builder and want more updates like these

[h1]Please leave a positive review![/h1]

This will [b]keep the game visible[/b] on Steam and keep the content creation alive.

notes.title: The Builder Seasons 1 and 2 released!
notes.content:
Four years of preparation and patron-supported development has led to [b]The Builder[/b] finally being released!

The two first seasons are out, Season 2 in early release, because I'm still working on Episode 10.

I've also created a [b]bundle[/b], so you get a discount when you buy both episodes as one.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Added story content[/h3]
I will add more content to both seasons as we progress. The first will be an update to Episode 1 - see below. After that, I will focus on finishing Episode 10. This will be the Season 2 finale, and will offer [b]six different possible paths[/b] through the dramatic events one single night.

[h3]Branching[/h3]
To make game play more interesting, I have a [b]number of story branches[/b] planned. The first wil kick in at the very beginning of the game, where you will get an option to say no to deliver the sample to the nurse. This will send you into a slightly different run towards the inevitable conclusion to the session at Fjord Energy offices.

[h3]Increased choice[/h3]
I have received requests for even more skipping options of content that some people find niche kinks. Duly noted, and I will implement this progressively.

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
Due to the Valve/Steam review process, I have a lot more [b]Steam Achievements[/b] planned that are not yet implemented. I will release them with the other updates.

[h3]Transfer of stats[/h3]
I'm currently looking into a simple way to transfer your stats from one season to the next. This way, your playing style will accumulate even more tweaks to the experience. This is slightly beyond my tech capacities, so I'll probably need some dev assistance on this.

[h3]Improved visuals[/h3]
Some sections of both seasons have slight unsatisfactory visual solutions, and I have an ambition to improve these.

[h3]More lewd content[/h3]
Once the story progresses past Episode 2, there's quite a few possibilities for lewd content that still can be explored. I'm also hoping to add more animations to the existing scenes, depending on my mastery of more advanced tools - and future development of AI assisted creation (that does not entail the AI doing what AI does: Making everything look AI). I want to keep this game human made all the way through.

[h2]The story continues[/h2]

[h3]Season 3[/h3]
Season 3 is scheduled for development starting Q3 2025 with the first release hoping to be early Q4. The episode will use a slightly different story mechanic because of the shift in motivation for the MC. This is still on the drawing board, so it's too early to say if my ideas can actually be made functional.

[h3]Seasons 4 - 6[/h3]
With 30 episodes planned, The Builder will have a total of 6 seasons before the story line reaches its conclusion. The reception of The Builder on Steam, will of course influence the pace of releases in the future.

Thank you for purchasing and following The Builder!

Chris / Lewd Robotics
